articles.title: More than 60 U.S. stocks including Nvidia and Tesla are headed onchain. Here’s how it works
articles.snippet: The planned 24/7 venue will offer dozens of tokenized U.S. stocks, with trades conducted against stablecoins through blockchain-based liquidity pools rather than a traditional order book.

articles.title: ECB policymaker warns of fragmentation without digital euro
articles.snippet: A ECB executive board member said the potential introduction of a digital euro would not ”take over the role of banks,” but ensure they have a role in the EU’s monetary system.

articles.title: OKX exchange raises fresh capital at $25B valuation
articles.snippet: OKX raised an undisclosed amount at a $25 billion valuation as an extension to March’s investment round led by the parent company of the New York Stock Exchange.

articles.title: Hong Kong officials double down on end-2026 deadline for crypto licensing bill
articles.snippet: Hong Kong regulators plan to establish a licensing regime for four categories, including digital asset trading, custody, advisory and management services.

articles.title: Ondo opens private markets with tokenized pre-IPO AI exposure
articles.snippet: Ondo’s tokenized notes will give eligible investors exposure to private companies, with the first tied to an unnamed pre-IPO AI company.
